name: dot-board
title: Dot Board
description: A departures board of LED dots whose lines light in a left-to-right sweep when their text changes.

perf.budget: One Skia canvas; the dots are prebuilt paths and the sweep only moves a clip on the UI thread. Nothing animates at rest.

measurements.notes: Frames at rest come from the demo, which changes departure every 4 s. A board with unchanged text draws nothing.

a11y.reducedMotion: Dots appear lit at once, with no sweep.
a11y.screenReader: The title, subtitle and every line read as one label ("Next Departure. Your ride leaves from gate twelve. 08:45. KYOTO. NZ204").
